intro.text: A creature of Roshar that grows in clusters, as on the docks of Kharbranth. What it feeds on is unknown.
A mollusk of Roshar with two shells, pearly in some kinds, that open and close in rhythm. Haspers grow in clusters, and what they eat is unknown.

description.text: Haspers live across eastern Roshar: on Kharbranth's docks, around Hearthstone and down in the Shattered Plains chasms. They breed during the Weeping, when clusters seem to appear from nowhere.
The shells enclose a slimy body, and their rhythmic opening makes haspers look like tiny breathing mouths.
They seem to stay fixed in one place all their lives, clinging to stone, wood or shalebark, and a cluster can bear the weight of a few waterskins.
One kind, the stranna hasper, is cooked and eaten.

items.text: Just before she discovered the humans, Eshonai had eaten steamed haspers.
After training Shallan with a Shardblade, Adolin brought a platter to her rooms in Urithiru that included steamed stranna haspers.
